name: lulu-road-trip
description: Lulu's Road Trip — native iOS wrapper (Capacitor) for the web game at lulu.boats.

ota.//: The iPhone app's over-the-air updates (IOS_BUILD.md › Updates from the server). minNative = the lowest APP version (the version above, which Codemagic stamps into the app) that can run the web game from this commit. Raise BOTH together whenever native code changes: a plugin added/updated, capacitor.config.json, Info.plist keys, the ad SDK, the icon.

scripts.add:ios: npm run build && npm run copy:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npm run copy:web && npx cap sync ios
